verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API directly, and the Invoicing API (including invoice preview) gives agents a way to query invoice data. The evidence does not show how the specific billing-state questions in the story would be answered. Missing for 10: documented MRR querying, delinquent-account listing via agent/API, upcoming-renewal queries, an explicit list of the MCP server's invoice/customer read tools, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can answer questions about my billing state — MRR, delinquent accounts, upcoming renewals, a customer's invoices — by querying the platform directly

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
use the Invoicing API and advanced features to automate how you collect and reconcile payments.
